info.title: Hostel Booking API
info.description: REST API shared by the website and the Flutter app. All responses use the {data, meta} / {error} envelope.

post.summary: Create an account (guest or owner)
Sign in with email and password
Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token (serialise calls client-side)
Revoke a refresh-token family (idempotent)
Sign out of every device
Confirm an email address with the emailed token
Resend the verification email (same response for unknown emails)
Request a password-reset email (same response for unknown emails)
Set a new password with the emailed token
Sign in / up with a Google ID token (web or mobile)

get.summary: Search listings (geo, dates, filters, keyset pagination). meta.total is returned on the first page only; X-Cache: HIT|MISS
Lightweight map markers inside a bounding box (same filters as search)
Public listing detail by id or slug (cached; invalidated on any change)
Availability and stay price per room type for given dates
Per-night availability and unit price (max 93 days), for date pickers

post.summary: Price a stay: price rules, GST, coupon, cancellation terms. Read-only (holds nothing). Optional bearer token enables per-user coupon limits

get.summary: Autocomplete for cities and listing names
Cities with listings, most popular first
Address/place search (OpenStreetMap Nominatim, cached 24h, rate limited)
Coordinates to address; null when nothing is found

post.summary: Book and hold the beds. Requires an Idempotency-Key header (409 PRICE_CHANGED if expectedTotalPaise is stale; 409 SOLD_OUT; 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT). Instant-book listings return PENDING_PAYMENT (pay within holdExpiresAt); request-to-book listings return PENDING_APPROVAL

get.summary: My bookings (keyset pagination; when=upcoming|past|all)
One booking with timeline, payment, refund, allowed actions and cancellation terms
What a cancellation right now would refund

post.summary: Cancel my booking (refund per the cancellation policy). Optional Idempotency-Key
Start (or resume) payment for a booking waiting for it. Returns the open order; retry after a failure creates a new one

get.summary: Payment status (poll after paying; confirmation arrives asynchronously by webhook)

post.summary: Demo gateway only: simulate the guest paying with a test instrument (DEMO_SUCCESS | DEMO_FAIL | DEMO_PENDING | DEMO_TIMEOUT)
Gateway callback (HMAC-signed, X-Demo-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>). Idempotent by event id

get.summary: Bookings at my properties
Booking detail for the host (guest contact revealed once confirmed)

post.summary: Accept a request; the guest then has a payment window
Decline a request (beds are released, nothing was charged)
Check a guest in (from the check-in date)
Complete a stay (from the check-out date); releases the owner share
Record a no-show: payment retained, future nights return to sale
Cancel a confirmed booking: the guest is refunded in full

get.summary: Earnings from the ledger: settled, upcoming and per property
All bookings

post.summary: Register a push token (FCM/APNs). Idempotent; a token moves to the signed-in account. Delivery is switched on in a later phase
